verdict.line: You out-trade Darius levels 3-5 with Q+E combos, but the lane slips away once it drags past level 6 into his Hemorrhage stacking and Guillotine threat, matching the measured 40.8% win rate over 103 games.

brief.thesis: Kled's hook-and-dash burst wins the early trades, which is why OP.GG tags this as a lane and solo-kill advantage, but Darius' Hemorrhage stacking and Noxian Guillotine execute scale past level 6 faster than Kled's kit does, so the early lead doesn't convert into the win column. That gap between 'early advantage' and a 40.8% measured win rate is the whole story of this matchup.

theirWindow.what: Darius closes safely (often with Ghost) and goes for Apprehend (E) to pull you into range, then stacks Hemorrhage with Decimate and Crippling Strike before threatening Noxian Guillotine (R) once he hits 6.

yourWindow.what: Open with Q (Bear Trap on a Rope) to yank him in, chain E (Jousting) for the dash and speed burst, then pop W (Violent Tendencies) for the four-attack speed spike — this is your measured lane and solo-kill advantage window, before his Hemorrhage stacking out-scales it.

start.why: The 83% pick rate and 40.2% baseline reflect the sustain and AD you need to actually win the early trades this matchup gives you.

boots.why: 82.5% pick rate; flat damage reduction blunts Darius' repeated autos and Decimate swings during extended fights.

core.why: Builds into your hook-and-dash trade pattern with wave-clear and bonus proc damage on your Q/E combo.
Armor shred directly counters Darius' own armor penetration from Apprehend and his tanky itemization as the game goes long.
Survivability against his Hemorrhage burst and the Noxian Guillotine true-damage spike once he's past level 6.

runes.keystoneWhy: This page measures 50% win rate versus Conqueror's 41%, and the sustain fits the actual problem: your early burst doesn't always finish the fight before Darius' passive stacks and true-damage R take over, so you need the extra max HP and healing to win the longer trades.

summoners.why: This combo posts the best measured result here (57.1% win rate) because Exhaust directly cuts the Decimate/Guillotine burst and the enraged AD Darius gets at max Hemorrhage stacks — the exact thing that flips this lane against you late.

playing.title: Trade with the full combo, not autos
playing.detail: Use Q (Bear Trap on a Rope, 800 range, 11-7s CD) to yank him in, then follow with E (Jousting, 550 range, 13-9s CD) for the dash and speed burst. Don't trade plain autos — every hit stacks his Hemorrhage and he enrages at 5 stacks.

playing.title: Don't stand in Apprehend range
playing.detail: Stay outside 535 range unless you're the one initiating. Darius' E (Apprehend) passively shreds your armor and its active sweep punishes you mid-disengage — this is the matchup's clearest measured read.

playing.title: Expect Ghost once your E is down
playing.detail: Track your own E (Jousting) cooldown all lane. Once it's down you have no dash to re-engage or disengage, and that's exactly when Darius closes the gap safely.

playing.title: Respect R at level 6 and up
playing.detail: Noxian Guillotine (120/100/80/6/6s CD) deals true damage scaled by Hemorrhage stacks and refreshes on a kill. Don't fight below roughly 40% HP once he's 6, especially while dismounted.

playing.title: Use your dismount to disengage, not continue
playing.detail: When Skaarl's health depletes, your Q becomes Pocket Pistol — a knockback that restores courage. Use it to create space from Darius rather than pushing the all-in, since dismounted Kled deals reduced champion damage.

playing.title: Force fights before his core items land
playing.detail: Your measured lane and solo-kill advantage lives in the levels 3-5 window, before Titanic Hydra and Black Cleaver come online. Pop W (Violent Tendencies) for the four-attack speed spike and force the fight here instead of scaling passively.

playing.title: Save R for the shutdown, not the opener
playing.detail: Chaaaaaaaarge!!! (140-110s CD, 3500 range) is best used to finish him after a trade or answer his all-in with the shield and ram. A whiffed charge leaves you without your engage or peel tool for over two minutes.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and the 40.8% head-to-head win rate over 103 games are measured on the current patch from OP.GG; the level-by-level reasoning and trade windows are my own read of the kit.
